prompt_en: Create a cinematic photorealistic spring street scene in a quiet traditional Japanese neighborhood, shot in landscape 16:9. Pale pink cherry blossom branches fill the upper left foreground and continue as soft blooming trees into the distance, with delicate petals catching warm morning sunlight. Use shallow depth of field: the foreground blossoms and nearby house details are sharp while the street and background buildings fade into gentle bokeh. Overlay exactly 1 large white Japanese kanji character in the center, reading 花, set in a bold elegant Mincho-style serif calligraphic font with clean high-contrast strokes. The character should be opaque white, vertically and horizontally centered, large enough to dominate the composition while still allowing blossoms and the street to remain visible around and behind it. The number is filled with soft blush-pink and champagne decorations: exactly 4 balloons visible, exactly 5 large peony-like flowers, many small pale pink blossom clusters, and warm fairy lights tucked throughout. Use dreamy soft studio lighting from the upper right, creamy shadows, shallow depth of field, elegant pastel pink, ivory, champagne, and beige tones, with a polished editorial photography look. Add centered typography below the number: small spaced uppercase text “CELEBRATING”, large elegant handwritten script “Two Years”, spaced uppercase serif text “OF PURE HAPPINESS”, and a tiny decorative line with leaves and a heart, followed by spaced uppercase text “HERE’S TO MORE MAGIC AHEAD” with small sparkle icons at both ends. title: 单色漫画章节拼贴
author: こやくちゃん
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,动漫 / 漫画,漫画 / 图像小说,角色,城市景观 / 街景
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a monochrome manga magazine cover / chapter splash page for なるようになるまで, with the episode label 第4話. The page should feel like a quiet, dialogue-free slice-of-life urban story, highly detailed and atmospheric.

Canvas: Vertical manga page, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, black-and-white ink drawing with grayscale screentone, dense crosshatching, rain reflections, high detail, no color.

Layout: A collage composition with exactly 7 visible story scenes. The largest central scene shows the main character standing full-body in a narrow rainy Tokyo alley, surrounded by tall buildings, utility poles, shop signs, wet pavement, a manhole cover, and a distant broadcast tower. Around it, arrange 6 smaller rectangular vignette panels: 1 upper-left cramped bedroom scene, 1 upper-right convenience-store cashier scene, 1 middle-left tabletop budgeting scene, 1 middle-right laundromat waiting scene, 1 lower-left rooftop city-view scene with pigeons, and 1 lower-right nighttime bedroom scene.

Subject details: The same teenage manga girl appears in all 7 scenes. She has short dark bobbed hair with a small ahoge curl, large over-ear headphones, a loose oversized hoodie jacket with sporty sleeve tape, a pleated skirt in the central full-body scene, chunky futuristic sneakers, and a tired introverted posture. Her face should be intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular gray blur in the largest central figure and the closer vignette figures, creating an anonymous censored look while preserving the hair and headphones silhouette. Use 893 as a small printed number or patch on the jacket in several scenes.

Exact scene count and contents: Scene 1, central full-body alley portrait: the girl stands hands in pockets, wet street reflections, dense Japanese urban signage, overhead wires, and a distant tower. Scene 2, upper-left bedroom: she sits on a messy bed looking at a phone, surrounded by clothes, bottles, posters, small table clutter, and a window. Scene 3, upper-right convenience store: she works at a register with shelves of canned goods and products behind her, wearing the same headphones and jacket. Scene 4, middle-left tabletop: she sits at a table with a cup-noodle container, bottled tea, coins, calculator, receipts, a wallet, and papers, suggesting budgeting or counting change. Scene 5, middle-right laundromat: she sits alone beside round washing machines, head down, with a large bag nearby. Scene 6, lower-left rooftop: she sits with a cup noodle and chopsticks overlooking a dense city skyline, with exactly 3 pigeons visible nearby and a drink bottle on the ground. Scene 7, lower-right bedroom at night: she lies awake in bed under blankets, city lights visible through the window, a digital clock on the wall or shelf, cup, phone, remote, small devices, and clutter on a bedside table.

Typography: Put the large brush-calligraphy title across the very top, bold black ink strokes with splatter and rough dry-brush texture. Place the smaller episode label below the left side of the title. Keep the typography integrated like a manga chapter opener.

Visual style: Detailed seinen manga line art, gritty urban realism, rainy Tokyo backstreets, cinematic composition, layered panels, ink splatter, screentone shading, high contrast, melancholy mood, no speech bubbles, no dialogue, no color, no watermark. Use quiet melancholy after rain as the emotional tone.\

author: Masao.N
categories: 应用 / 网页设计,3D 渲染,极简主义,图解 / 图表,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a polished mobile onboarding/top screen for a fictional B2B data platform named NOVALITH, in a premium Japanese SaaS visual style.

Canvas: Vertical smartphone screenshot, 9:16 aspect ratio, white background, iOS status bar at the top showing 9:41 with signal, Wi-Fi, and battery icons. Use generous margins and a clean app-advertising composition.

Layout: Place the NOVALITH logo near the top left, with a geometric turquoise-blue “N” mark and wide-spaced navy wordmark. Below it, set a large bold Japanese headline in dark navy: データを、未来の意思決定に変える。. Under the headline, add a smaller two-line Japanese description: 開発・運用・データの複雑さを解消し、信頼できるデータ基盤で、事業の成長を加速させます。. On the lower left, show exactly 3 feature blurbs with thin cyan outline icons: 1) stacked layers icon, title “統合された基盤”, description “データとシステムを一元的に統合”; 2) shield check icon, title “堅牢なガバナンス”, description “セキュリティと品質を標準で確保”; 3) rising bar chart icon, title “高速な意思決定”, description “信頼できるデータで意思決定を加速”.

Hero visual: On the right half, create a large glossy 3D smartphone card tilted slightly backward, overlapping a translucent teal-blue architectural block and a giant faceted 3D letter N behind it. The phone screen shows a Japanese dashboard UI with exactly 4 dashboard sections: 1) top metric cards, with “データパイプライン 128 +2.4%” and “データ品質スコア 98.6% +2.4%”; 2) pipeline status row with three connected icons labeled “データソース 24”, “処理中 128”, and “出力先 36”, plus small status dots; 3) line chart titled “データ量の推移” with dates from 5/06 to 5/12; 4) donut chart titled “データソース健全性” showing “96% 健全” and a legend with “健全 46”, “警告 3”, “エラー 1”. Keep the dashboard text small but believable and neatly aligned.

Bottom navigation and actions: Center exactly 3 small carousel dots above the buttons; the first dot is teal and active, the other two are pale gray. Add exactly 2 rounded buttons at the bottom: a filled teal gradient primary button labeled はじめる with a right arrow icon, and a white secondary button with teal outline labeled あとで始める.

Visual style: Futuristic enterprise data analytics, crisp vector UI mixed with soft 3D glassmorphism. Palette is white, deep navy, cyan, teal, and aqua gradients. Add subtle polygon network lines, tiny nodes, faint dotted patterns, and light geometric overlays across the background. Use soft shadows, clean Japanese typography, high contrast, and a premium App Store marketing feel. Avoid clutter, avoid extra buttons, avoid extra feature items, and do not add watermarks.\

title: 屋顶酒吧夜景情侣

prompt_en: A wide half-body shot of two young people standing at the railing of an open-air rooftop club bar, authentic daily life photography, natural candid moment. She leans back lightly against him — both looking out at the city lights below, drinks in hand, a comfortable weight to the silence between them.\nEast Asian young woman in her early 20s. Almond-shaped eyes with natural double eyelids, slightly elongated eye corners, expression soft and open — the kind of face that appears when the music is behind you and the city is in front. Straight refined nose with a delicate bridge. Skin tone fair to light beige (NC10–NC20). Skin subsurface scattering visible under warm rooftop bar light mixed with distant city glow, specular micro-highlights on her bare shoulders and collarbone, fine foundation powder grain perceptible. She wears a rose-gold satin slip dress on thin straps — the fabric catching the city light, hem above the knee, moving faintly in the night breeze. He stands close behind her, hands loosely on the railing beside hers. Two or three stray hairs lift and cross her cheek displaced by the rooftop breeze, natural unplanned imperfection, not geometrically symmetrical.\nMixed artificial light sources — warm amber rooftop bar lanterns cast a soft glow across both figures from behind. The vast city light grid spreads below and behind them, bokeh points of orange and white light filling the distance. A light wind is implied in the fabric movement and lifted hair. The mood is gentle and warm — quiet contentment, a small almost-smile, sense of stillness above the city. Subtle ISO 400 film grain in shadow areas, photographic noise texture not CG render smoothness. Aspect ratio 3:2. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digitally painted, not illustration, not anime.\

Use my uploaded portrait only as the identity reference. Only reference the person’s real facial features, face shape, proportions, skin tone, hairstyle, hair texture, and overall natural appearance. Do not copy the original clothing, background, lighting, expression, or image quality from the uploaded portrait. The generated person must still look like the same real person. Do not change the person into someone else. Do not over-beautify. Do not make the skin look plastic. Do not make it anime-like or doll-like.

Create a highly realistic outdoor summer garden selfie in a vertical composition. The framing should be farther away than a close-up selfie, showing more of the upper body and part of the outfit, with a natural arm-extended selfie perspective. The subject is looking directly at the camera with a soft, gentle, relaxed expression and a slight smile. The head can be slightly tilted, and both arms should be visible extending toward the camera in a natural selfie pose. The perspective should feel like a real handheld phone selfie, with mild wide-angle distortion, but not exaggerated.

The setting is a bright outdoor flower garden filled with blooming purple roses, lush green leaves, and a clear blue sky in the background. The floral wall should feel dense, vivid, fresh, and summery. The subject is wearing a woven straw sun hat with a wide brim and delicate white lace trim around the edge. The hat may include subtle summer decorations such as small white-yellow plumeria flowers and small starfish accessories, keeping the styling elegant and playful, not cartoonish.

Generate suitable summer clothing automatically based on the uploaded person’s appearance and temperament. Do not lock the clothing to one exact design, but make it stylish, natural, feminine, and suitable for a sunny flower garden selfie. The outfit should harmonize with the purple rose environment, and light purple or other soft summer tones are preferred. Clothing fabric should look real, with natural texture and folds.

Use strong but realistic natural summer sunlight. Let the sunlight pass through the hat and create delicate dappled light and shadow patterns on the face, shoulders, and arms. Hair should have realistic strands and a few loose flyaway hairs, with soft sunlit rim light around the edges.

The overall image should look like a real high-quality smartphone selfie or digital camera selfie, with authentic photographic realism, natural depth of field, vivid floral colors, and a clean, dreamy summer atmosphere. No text, no watermark, no logo, no AI label, and no border.

title: 偷拍的夜间屋顶肖像
author: mugitan
categories: 社交媒体帖子,摄影,复古 / 怀旧,肖像 / 自拍,城市景观 / 街景
prompt_en:
Please use the uploaded image as a base. Completely preserve the original facial features, personality, skin color, and body type.

[Concept]
An 'instant of memory' accidentally captured on a quiet night, never intended to be shown to anyone. A realistic coolness with slight oddities and negative space.

[Situation]
Night rooftop. No one is around, with city neons and building lights dimly scattered in the distance. Smoking a cigarette alone.

[Atmosphere/Story]
A slightly chilly night air. An ambiguous time where it's unclear if they are lost in thought or thinking of nothing. A moment of quiet escape, with no premise of being watched.

[Pose/Body]
A relaxed, natural posture. Slightly hunched with shoulders dropped. A rough way of standing with weight on one leg. A state of just being there without posing.

[Expression]
Eyes are a bit heavy, with the focus slightly shifted. An ambiguous gaze that almost notices the camera for a second before immediately looking away.

[Movement (Important)]
A sudden gust of wind causes the hair and smoke to sway irregularly.

[Cigarette State]
Just before exhaling smoke, or just after. Smoke in the middle of dissolving and spreading into the air. An unstable state where ash is about to fall.

[Details]
Strands of hair lightly touching the cheek or lips. Lips are slightly dry. Slight tiredness around the eyes. Skin should maintain a natural texture, not overly polished.

[Photography Style]
A photo that looks like it was accidentally taken with a smartphone. A slightly tilted composition, framing off-center. A shutter delay of half a step, resulting in a very slight blur.

[Light]
City neons or distant streetlights are the main light sources. Light hitting the face weakly from one direction, and bokeh from point light sources in the background. High contrast where only part has strong highlights and the rest falls into darkness.

[Background]
A rooftop with a sense of daily life, including fences, pipes, and concrete. City lights visible in dots through the darkness.

[Texture]
VSCO style. Low contrast, slight fading, film grain, light noise. Some graininess in the shadows, not completely clear.

[Gaze Oddity]
A very slight misalignment where eyes seem to almost meet but don't.

[Composition Errors]
The subject's head or shoulder slightly out of frame, or unnatural negative space.

[Light Noise]
Lights from distant neons or streetlights reflecting off smoke or the lens, slightly bleeding.

[Hook]
A sense of discomfort and intrigue, as if accidentally witnessing a private night moment you weren't supposed to see.

[Important]
Never change the person's face or personality. Prioritize realism and imperfection over being too pretty.\

Color grading: cold teal-blue moonlight mixed with warm orange lava glow, dramatic contrast, volumetric fog, realistic shadows, cinematic atmosphere. Aspect ratio: ultra-wide storyboard sheet, professional Hollywood pre-production design. PANEL 1 — “Frozen Ruins” Wide aerial establishing shot of a devastated frozen ruin at night. Shattered icy ground, drifting fog, ancient broken pillars covered in frost, snow blowing through the ruins. Tiny exhausted dark-haired woman visible lying on the ice. Bullet points inside panel: • Wide aerial establishing shot • Blue moonlight reflections • Heavy atmospheric fog • Ancient frozen ruins PANEL 2 — “The Fallen Woman” Medium-wide shot of the exhausted woman lying on cracked ice. Torn black-gray clothing, pale skin, trembling fingers, visible breath in cold air. Emotion: pain, desperation, exhaustion. Bullet points: • Character introduction • Torn dark clothing • Ice texture detail • Emotional vulnerability PANEL 3 — “Pain Awakens” Close-up on her face as she struggles to rise. Frost on skin, strands of dark hair across face, eyes filled with fear. Small glowing orange cracks begin appearing beneath her skin. Bullet points: • Close-up emotional shot • Molten glow beneath skin • Fear and desperation • Cinematic push-in camera PANEL 4 — “Lava Veins” Extreme close-up of glowing lava-like cracks spreading across her arm and neck. Skin illuminated from within by molten orange energy. Ice beneath her starts cracking violently. Bullet points: • Transformation begins • Orange magma veins • Cracking frozen ground • High-detail skin deformation PANEL 5 — “Bone Shift” Dynamic side-angle shot of her spine bending unnaturally while fingers elongate. Bones visibly shifting under skin with realistic body horror deformation. Fog and snow swirl around violently. Bullet points: • Spine deformation • Aggressive morphing • Dynamic camera angle • Violent environmental reaction PANEL 6 — “Flesh to Fur” Mid-transformation sequence. Human body partially dissolving into black fur and panther anatomy. Limbs reshaping fluidly. Embers erupt into the cold air. Bullet points: • Flesh reforming • Fur generation effects • Embers and debris • Seamless morph VFX PANEL 7 — “The Beast Emerges” Full reveal of the massive black panther standing on shattered ice. Glowing lava cracks across body, fiery orange eyes, steam rising from fur. Dramatic moonlight silhouette. Bullet points: • Full creature reveal • Lava crack patterns • Cinematic silhouette • Dark fantasy realism PANEL 8 — “Roar of Fury” Intense close-up action shot of the panther roaring directly toward camera. Motion blur, handheld shake energy, flying debris, glowing embers, ultra-detailed fur simulation. Bullet points: • Aggressive roar shot • Handheld camera shake • Flying debris particles • High-intensity action PANEL 9 — “Storm Transition” Final cinematic frame. The roaring panther sharply turns its head toward the sky as dark storm clouds begin forming overhead. Blue lightning faintly visible in distance. Dramatic ending composition. prompt_en:
Goal: Create a clean studio photo collage showing two adult women posing with a vintage black military motorcycle with a sidecar. The women should have intentionally anonymized, softly blurred faces while the rest of the image remains sharp.

Canvas: 4:3 horizontal canvas, white seamless studio background, soft even lighting, realistic high-resolution photography, thin white gutters dividing the collage.

Layout: Use exactly 4 panels in a 2x2 collage. Panel 1 is the largest-feeling front three-quarter view on the upper left, showing the full motorcycle and sidecar angled toward the right. Panel 2 is the upper right front view, slightly smaller and more centered. Panel 3 is the lower left rear/side view, showing the back of the sidecar and spare tire. Panel 4 is the lower right close-up crop of the two women seated on the motorcycle and in the sidecar.

Subjects: Include exactly 2 women. Woman 1 is blonde, seated relaxed in the sidecar with one arm resting on the sidecar edge and one leg bent. Woman 2 has black hair pulled back neatly, seated on the motorcycle saddle holding the handlebars. Both wear identical fitted white military-style uniform jackets with silver buttons, shoulder epaulets, belted waists, short skirt-like lower hems, and white knee-high boots. Keep the look polished, formal, and slightly retro-futuristic.

Vehicle details: The motorcycle is a vintage matte black sidecar motorcycle with a round headlamp, spoked wheels, thick tread tires, black fenders, exposed handlebars, a worn metal fuel tank, a rectangular front-mounted sidecar storage box, and a spare tire mounted behind the sidecar. Make the vehicle look heavy, old, functional, and military-inspired.

Panel details: Count exactly 4 distinct views: 1 front-left three-quarter full vehicle view, 1 frontal full vehicle view, 1 rear-left side view, and 1 close-up seated portrait crop. Keep the same two women and the same motorcycle consistent across all panels.

Style constraints: Photorealistic studio product photography, white/gray shadowed floor, no text, no logos, no watermark, no outdoor scenery, no extra people, no additional vehicles. Faces must be obscured with smooth rectangular or oval blur masks rather than detailed facial features.\

title: YOLOv13架构图
author: Keigo Nakano
categories: 信息图 / 教育视觉,极简主义,图解 / 图表,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a clean technical architecture diagram explaining YOLOv13 as a one-page educational slide, showing how an input image flows through Backbone, HyperACE, Neck, FullPAD, and Head detection outputs.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 landscape infographic on a white background, crisp vector style, thin colored outlines, rounded rectangles, arrowed connectors, and readable sans-serif text. Use a left-to-right pipeline with supplementary modules below the main path.

Layout: Start at far left with a small stacked thumbnail illustration labeled “Input Image (3, H, W)”, then an arrow into a large blue Backbone panel. Place the green Neck panel in the upper center, the purple Head panel on the right, HyperACE in the lower left-center, FullPAD in the lower center-right, and a boxed explanatory caption along the bottom.

Main pipeline sections and exact element counts:
- 1 Input Image stack at far left, shown as layered landscape photos.
- 1 Backbone panel titled “Backbone” with subtitle “(built from DS-C3k2 blocks)”. Inside it, show exactly 5 vertically stacked DS-C3k2 block boxes labeled B1, B2, B3, B4, B5. Put “/2” downsampling markers between each adjacent block, for exactly 4 downsampling labels. Add side output arrows: B1 and B2 go right and are labeled “B1 (unused)” and “B2 (unused)”; B3, B4, and B5 go right in blue and are labeled “B3 (C3, H/8, W/8)”, “B4 (C4, H/16, W/16)”, and “B5 (C5, H/32, W/32)”.
- 1 HyperACE module below the Backbone, orange outline, titled “HyperACE” with subtitle “(Hypergraph-based Adaptive Correlation Enhancement) Eq.8-11”. Inside it, include one dashed rounded note box saying “Models cross-scale and cross-position high-order and low-order correlations”. Blue lines from B3/B4/B5 feed into HyperACE. HyperACE outputs an orange arrow to a small orange 3D cube labeled “Y” and “Correlation-enhanced feature”.
- 1 Neck panel in the upper center, green outline, titled “Neck” with subtitle “(built from DS-C3k2 blocks)”. Inside it show exactly 6 DS-C3k2 block boxes arranged in a 2-column by 3-row grid. Use black arrows between blocks, with exactly 2 yellow upsample boxes labeled “↑ 2×” and exactly 2 purple downsample boxes labeled “↓ 2×”. Include 3 blue circular input junctions on the left edge of the Neck and 3 green/purple circular tunnel markers below or beside the grid.
- 1 FullPAD legend module below the Neck, red outline, titled “FullPAD” with subtitle “(Full-Pipeline Aggregation-and-Distribution) Eq.12-13”. Show exactly 3 legend rows: “Backbone–Neck tunnel (Backbone-to-Neck connection)” using blue dotted arrows and blue hollow circles; “In-Neck tunnel (the internal layers of the Neck)” using green dotted arrows and green hollow circles; “Neck–Head tunnel (Neck-to-Head connection)” using purple dotted arrows and purple hollow circles. Connect the cube feature into FullPAD with an orange arrow, and draw dotted blue/green/purple tunnel routes upward and rightward to the Neck and Head.
- 1 Head panel on the right, purple outline, titled “Head” with subtitle “(Detect x3)”. Inside it show exactly 3 vertically stacked Detect boxes: “Detect (stride 8)”, “Detect (stride 16)”, and “Detect (stride 32)”. Each receives one arrow from the Neck and outputs to the right as H3, H4, H5 with labels “H3 (scale 1/8)”, “H4 (scale 1/16)”, and “H5 (scale 1/32)”.

Color coding: Backbone lines and panel in blue, Neck in green, Head in purple, HyperACE in orange, FullPAD outline in red. Main arrows are solid; FullPAD tunnels are dotted/dashed with hollow circular nodes. Use subtle pastel fills for module boxes.

Bottom caption: Add one wide rounded rectangle spanning the lower width. Text: “Classic YOLO is a one-directional Backbone → Neck → Head pipeline.” Then on the next line: “YOLOv13 adds HyperACE and FullPAD on top of it to enhance feature representation and information flow.” Color the words Backbone blue, Neck green, Head purple, HyperACE orange, and FullPAD red.

Constraints: Keep all labels legible, align sections neatly, preserve the exact counts of blocks and detect heads, avoid extra modules, avoid photorealism except for the small input image thumbnail, and do not add a watermark.\

prompt_en:
A highly detailed grand-strategy game screenshot in the visual style of a modern Civilization-like city view, showing an isometric aerial perspective of a dense coastal Japanese metropolis built on a compact island surrounded by deep blue ocean. The city should feel like late-20th-century Tokyo Bay, with a believable mix of real-world-inspired landmarks and stylized strategy-game worldbuilding. In the center, place a red-orange steel broadcast tower resembling Tokyo Tower, surrounded by several traditional temple and pagoda complexes with green-tiled roofs, embedded seamlessly inside a forest of tightly packed mid-rise and high-rise concrete and glass buildings. Include exactly 1 red lattice tower, exactly 3 prominent traditional temple or shrine complexes, exactly 2 multi-tier pagodas, exactly 1 large waterside stadium near the upper center shoreline, and exactly 1 monumental statue on a headland at the left edge of the island. The urban fabric should be extremely dense, with narrow streets, elevated roads, billboards, rooftop details, cherry blossom trees scattered through districts, commercial signage, docks, piers, warehouses, and mixed residential and office blocks. The shoreline must be irregular and heavily developed with harbors and ferry terminals, and the surrounding water should contain exactly 12 visible vessels of mixed types: ferries, small motorboats, workboats, yachts, and 1 tall-masted sailing ship near the lower right. Render the water in rich teal-to-navy gradients with shallow coastal transparency and detailed wakes.

Present it explicitly as a video game interface screenshot. Add a thin top status bar with resource counters and turn information; the upper right should read Turn: 103, 1992 CE, 2:51 PM. Place exactly 7 leader banners across the upper right, each with a different color and emblem, and include a diplomacy panel naming Tokugawa Ieyasu of the Japanese Empire. On the left side, add a vertical journal panel titled Journal with 3 quest entries and small circular icons. In the lower left, include exactly 1 minimap framed in ornate UI styling. In the lower right, include a large circular command interface with metallic bronze-and-gold ornamentation and a button labeled GROW TOWN; around it place exactly 3 smaller circular action buttons. The overall interface should feel premium, intricate, and historically flavored rather than futuristic.

The city itself should evoke Tokyo, Japan in 1992 CE, recreated as a lush, polished, slightly idealized 4X strategy game screenshot with cinematic lighting, crisp miniature-like detail, realistic urban density, authentic Japanese transportation and waterfront infrastructure, and a color palette of ocean blue, concrete gray, greenery, copper UI metals, and pops of neon signage. Use a high-angle three-quarter camera, sharp focus across the whole city, and richly textured, painterly-realistic rendering consistent with gpt-image-2 game concept screenshot output.\

Main map: An isometric/top-down high-detail fantasy region map titled REGIÓN DE ELDORAN with subtitle ~68h DE JUEGO in an ornate dark plaque at the top right. The region has a snowy mountain range across the top, dense green forests, winding rivers, a turquoise lake, wetlands and marshes on the right, rocky hills, a glowing orange geological fault running vertically near the right side, and a fortified harbor city at the bottom center opening into a teal sea with small islands and docks. Use dramatic clouds and fog around the edges, especially the bottom left and right border, for an unexplored-map feeling.

Legend: Add a dark rectangular ornate legend box near the upper left of the map titled “LEYENDA”. It must contain exactly 15 labeled rows with small icons: 1 Ciudad Portuaria Desarrollada, 2 Asentamiento Sin Desarrollar, 3 Puerto Menor, 4 Yacimiento de Cristal de Maná, 5 Mina en Producción, 6 Mina Abandonada, 7 Vetas de Hierro Expuestas, 8 Río Principal, 9 Río Menor, 10 Lago, 11 Humedales / Pantanos, 12 Bosque Frondoso, 13 Sierras / Montañas, 14 Falla Geológica, 15 Zona Sin Explorar.

The map should feel like a polished game-design concept board, with realistic terrain textures, ornate fantasy UI frames, warm gold typography, and no modern UI elements.

title: 黑暗中国奇幻欲望海报
author: Eric｜晓峰
categories: 海报 / 传单,水墨 / 中国风,插画,文字 / 排版,角色
prompt_en: A dark epic Chinese fantasy poster centered on the single gold calligraphy character 欲 dominating the upper left, rendered in huge textured brushed gold ink with rough edges and metallic leaf-like highlights. The scene is a cavernous infernal passage in deep black, bronze, and molten amber tones, lit by a blinding sacred glow at the top of a long stone staircase. At the top center-right stands an ornate golden lotus lamp or ritual chalice radiating holy light like a sun halo. In the lower center, show 1 lone ragged human figure from behind, slim and exhausted, wearing tattered dark robes shredded by the wind, reaching one arm upward toward the light while standing on a cracked stone path that becomes stairs. Flowing through the composition are 6 visible crimson silk ribbons or smoke-like fabric strands curling dramatically from left, right, and foreground, adding motion. Carve or inscribe 5 clearly visible Chinese characters onto broken stone slabs along the path and lower foreground: 情, 贪, 嗔, 痴, 慢, each glowing faintly in warm gold. Build the cave walls from writhing organic rock and shadow, with 3 large ghostly human faces emerging from the stone on the left and right sides, as if embodiments of temptation and suffering. Include 2 monstrous clawed hands reaching inward from the lower right toward the traveler. On the left side beneath the large title character, place 1 vertical block of elegant Chinese poem text in small gold calligraphy, plus 1 red seal stamp beside it. Along the bottom margin, add 1 horizontal line of small gold Chinese text with decorative dividers and the central highlighted character 心, plus 1 additional small red seal at the lower right. The overall style is cinematic, ultra-detailed, mythic, spiritual, and ominous, mixing Buddhist allegory, dark fantasy, and premium poster design; volumetric lighting, glowing dust, dramatic contrast, intricate brush typography, high detail, vertical composition.\

categories: 海报 / 传单,动漫 / 漫画,极简主义,插画,抽象 / 背景,角色
prompt_en: Create a vertical 2:3 abstract anime illustration on an almost white background with lots of negative space. Show a dynamic, partially cropped futuristic anime girl or character fragment in translucent aqua and teal linework, tilted diagonally from upper left to lower right, with flowing cyan hair-like strands on the left, a glossy triangular turquoise glass-like form extending to the right, and a small white angular collar or garment shape near the lower center. Add bright yellow paint splashes and loose calligraphic strokes bursting from the upper-left side of the head, with thin cyan swoosh lines arcing around the top and left edges. Place one large centered square overlay in front of the character, covering the face and torso; the square should have a soft pastel gradient from pale yellow-green at the upper left to mint and light cyan at the lower right, with clean sharp edges and no text. Use an airy high-key color palette of aqua teal, bright yellow, white, and pale mint, with glossy highlights, sketchy anime line art, watercolor-like transparency, and energetic modern composition. Keep the image text-free, borderless, and poster-like.\

title: 英国短毛猫百科卡
author: 自学Ai的鱼头叔叔
categories: 信息图 / 教育视觉,极简主义,插画,动物 / 生物,图解 / 图表
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vertical encyclopedia-style atlas card for British Shorthair cat, designed like a polished Chinese science-popularization infographic.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 layout, warm ivory background, soft sage-green borders, rounded modular cards, subtle shadows, clean editorial spacing, high-resolution print quality.

Header: At the top left include a tiny book icon and the small atlas label in Chinese inside this parameter: 百科科普图鉴 CAT BREED ATLAS. Add a large dark-green Chinese headline using this parameter: 英国短毛猫. Under it place the English subtitle “British Shorthair” and a short Chinese descriptor line. Add three small pill tags with icons below the subtitle.

Main subject: Center-right dominant realistic studio photo of a British Shorthair cat: plush blue-gray coat, round face, dense fur, copper-gold eyes, upright ears, sitting front-facing with tail curled to the right. Background behind the cat is softly blurred home interior in beige tones.

Layout: Use exactly 9 labeled information modules, each with a green circular letter badge: A through I. Arrange A, B, C, D, E around the upper and middle area, F, G, H beneath them, and I as a full-width bottom feature strip. Each module is a rounded rectangle with pale cream fill and thin green outline.

Section count and contents: Include exactly these 9 modules: A Basic profile, B Appearance features, C Personality / behavior, D Feeding and care, E Risk and precautions, F Suitable owners, G Pros and cons comparison, H Quick rating, I Top 5 keywords. Use concise Chinese body copy and tiny icons, but keep the layout readable and not overcrowded.

Detail callouts: Add exactly 5 circular zoom-in detail callouts connected to the cat by thin leader lines: 1 large round eyes, 2 plush coat texture, 3 thick rounded tail, 4 dense chest / neck fur, 5 round paws / compact body feature. Each callout should contain a cropped macro image and a short Chinese label with a paragraph-length note.

Visible repeated elements: In section A include exactly 4 small coat-color cat head icons in a row. In section E include exactly 5 warning rows with red triangular warning icons. In section F include exactly 3 owner-suitability rows with green check icons and exactly 2 unsuitable rows with orange X icons. In section G include exactly 2 comparison columns, one green “advantages” column and one orange “disadvantages” column. In section H include exactly 6 rating rows, each with blue star ratings. In section I include exactly 5 keyword cards, numbered 1 to 5, each with a small icon: smiley face, male symbol, fish, small circular symbol, and heart.

Bottom photo strip: Along the bottom right, place exactly 4 small rounded photos of the cat showing lifestyle / posture scenes: sitting front view, standing side view, lying relaxed, curled up sleeping in a bed. Add small Chinese captions under each photo.

Visual style: Professional encyclopedia card, soft educational design, muted green and beige palette, realistic animal photography mixed with vector UI icons, thin dividers, rounded corners, compact but clean Chinese typography. Avoid neon colors, clutter, watermark, QR codes, or extra decorative text.\
